description: One fixture replayed against the pinned native oracle: the rules-layer decision observed, the invariant-level expectation, the verdict, and mandatory layer attribution. INV-005: a no-match MUST serialize as 'unknown', never 'allow'. INV-004: an unknown finding MUST carry layer_attribution (never a bare unknown, never allow).

invariant_expected.description: The invariant-level expectation array from the matching invariant (may contain 'unmatched-reported-as-unknown' for INV-004).

layer_attribution.description: MANDATORY on every unknown finding (INV-004). The canonical text: 'no rules-layer decision; runtime outcome depends on approval policy + sandbox under the pinned configuration.'

raw_native_output.description: Verbatim stdout of the native 'codex execpolicy check' invocation.

title: Boundary finding v1
